heading: Quick-fill expense planner · 13–19 October 2026

trip_items.name: Flights, baggage and seat fees (enter booking total)
trip_items.notes: No flight itinerary, traveler count, baggage choice or airfare was supplied. Enter the amount for your own booking; no route or price is assumed.

trip_items.name: AX ODYCY booking total
trip_items.notes: Enter the amount from your booking. Six nights applies only if check-in is 13 Oct and check-out is 19 Oct; exact hotel nights, room rate, payment and any separate charges are not confirmed here.

trip_items.name: Travel / medical insurance
trip_items.notes: Enter your policy quote or actual cost; coverage and reimbursement depend on your policy.

trip_items.name: Mobile roaming, eSIM or data add-on
trip_items.notes: Carrier and plan are unknown. Check the rate, allowance and activation with your own U.S. provider; no roaming charge is assumed.

notes: All amount fields start blank. Blank means not entered or not priced; it never means free.
The planner is EUR-first. No EUR/USD rate, meal budget, taxi estimate, tax, tip or event coverage is preloaded.
Any paid, prepaid or otherwise covered amount must be entered by the traveler; nothing is assumed to be reimbursed or covered.
Optional published prices below are references checked on 9 Oct 2026. They do not enter the total unless you deliberately add them, and they may change before the trip.
Food records do not support a representative meal total; use a current menu, quote, receipt or your own estimate.
